title: Fix Puzzle 3D Objects Not Rendering
description: Puzzle 3D shows only the grid. No object meshes are visible, including after dropping an object: the transform gumball appears for the selected object, but its mesh does not render. Trace the complete object-to-scene mesh path, fix the root cause, add regression coverage in existing tests, and verify runtime viewport behavior with console evidence.
summary: Fixed Puzzle 3D persistent mesh rendering end to end: URL-backed dropped meshes remain pending until fetched, GLB scene decoding collects transformed triangle primitives after guide-line primitives, the dev asset server stays responsive while Trunk runs, and WGPU selects the declared Puzzle 3D app in the shared multi-app plugin. Added regressions, repaired concurrent rename fallout required for builds, wired Rust tests into the renderer target, and verified 227 Rust tests, the WGPU JS test, core tests, registry generation, WASM build, mesh HTTP responses, and a clean live Puzzle 3D browser render with visible filled meshes.
